verdict.rationale: Adyen's Terminal API is well documented as a server-driven, JSON-based API for building custom POS checkouts (docs-17, docs-1, docs-2, plus refund/tipping/testing docs), and an OpenAPI spec exists on GitHub. However, a first-hand community account describes painful, hundred-hour integration efforts leading to abandoning Adyen for card-present, suggesting real-world friction not reflected in the docs.
